evidence_class: mocked: local files in a temporary folder stand in for a provider transcript; no provider process, spool or network runs
interfaces: hooks.memory.collector.read_batch(path, cursor) decodes only newline-terminated records after the committed offset and proposes the next cursor without writing it
hooks.memory.collector.Batch carries records, the proposed cursor, start, the speculative read end, pending trailing bytes, replayed and an identity naming generation and byte range
hooks.memory.collector.Collector.poll(path, accept) normalizes a batch once with the SES-01 decoders and commits the cursor only after accept returns
hooks.memory.cursors.CursorStore.load, commit and replays_total; commit is a compare-and-set on revision under a store lock with an atomic fsynced write
hooks.memory.cursors.Cursor holds source, device, inode, accepted offset, anchor, format, turn state, revision and replays

supported_versions.transcripts: Claude, Codex and Copilot JSONL through the SES-01 decoders; the bare JSON array variant stays on the whole-file reader

states.observed: Cases A, B and C each ran twice from independent temporary folders with identical records.
states.accepted: A complete appended line is ingested once; partial UTF-8 and JSON records and a refused acceptance leave the committed cursor bytes unchanged.
states.committed: Cursor files under the store root are the authoritative accepted offsets; the code and fixture are at tested_commit.
states.externally_verified: None: no provider session, spool or hive collector was exercised.

metrics.transcript_cursor_replays_total: CursorStore.replays_total; case A counts one replay each for rotation, truncation and regrowth

rollback_rehearsal.action: Stop the collector and retain cursor files with their generation, offset and revision so a controlled replay can rebuild projections.
rollback_rehearsal.authoritative_objects: Source transcript files and the cursor files; cursors are never deleted as caches.
rollback_rehearsal.proof: Case C keeps one cursor file after restart, the unchanged whole-file reader iter_transcript_records returns exactly the accepted records, and a collector on a fresh cursor folder replays the source into the same records.

remaining_limitations: Records a rotated file had not yet delivered before rotation are not read; the collector restarts on the new file.
A rewrite that keeps the same inode, a size at or above the offset and identical bytes in the anchor window is read as an append.
A complete final record without a trailing newline waits until a newline is written.

Two pollers on one source can both call accept for the same Batch.identity before one commit is refused as stale_cursor; the collector proves only the shared identity, and no duplicate authoritative effect depends on an idempotent accept, which the durable spool of SV2-SES-03 must provide.
The durable spool and supervisor wiring belong to SV2-SES-03.
